verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an LLM inference engine with a server mode, so disaggregating prefill and decode is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents splitting the prefill and decode phases across separate workers or nodes. The community note that prompt ingestion runs in fast batches unlike token generation describes how the phases perform differently, not disaggregated serving, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
